raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `SGLANG_DSPARK_EMBED_IN_GRAPH=0`, the DSpark draft worker embeds the draft block outside the model and passes the result as `input_embeds` with shape `[N, H]`. `DeepseekV4ForCausalLMDSpark` uses `input_embeds` as is, but its stages expect the hyper-connection layout `[N, hc_mult, H]` that `forward_embed` builds. On the eager draft path this fails in `mhc_pre` (`assert fn.shape[0] == hc_mult3`), so a server launched with `--disable-cuda-graph` and this env var dies during startup.

## Modifications

- Factor the `[N, H] -> [N, hc_mult, H]` expansion out of `forward_embed` into `_expand_hc`.
- Expand 2-D `input_embeds` in `_forward_impl`; 3-D embeds and the `input_embeds is None` path are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with its bundled DSpark head, on 2×B300 (`--tp 2 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --chunked-prefill-size 4096 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1`). This is the cookbook's Flash-0731 recipe at TP 2 instead of TP 4. sgl-eval GSM8K: 200 examples, 32 concurrent, T=0, thinking off.

| branch | config | result | GSM8K | accept length |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| main | `SGLANG_DSPARK_EMBED_IN_GRAPH=0`, `--disable-cuda-graph` | startup crash in `mhc_pre` | – | – |
| this PR | `SGLANG_DSPARK_EMBED_IN_GRAPH=0`, `--disable-cuda-graph` | serves | 98.5% | 4.46 |
| this PR | defaults (CUDA graphs on) | serves | 98.0% | 4.36 |

For reference, main with `SGLANG_DSPARK_EMBED_IN_GRAPH=0` and CUDA graphs on serves normally: 99.0%, accept length 4.35.

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

files.patch:
@@ -920,9 +920,10 @@ def forward_embed(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
                 "DeepseekV4ForCausalLMDSpark requires the target embed_tokens "
                 "(call attach_shared_modules first)."
             )
-        x = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
-        x = x.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, self.hc_mult, 1)
-        return x
+        return self._expand_hc(self.embed_tokens(input_ids))
+
+    def _expand_hc(self, embeds: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return embeds.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, self.hc_mult, 1)
 
     def forward(
         self,
@@ -948,6 +949,8 @@ def forward(
     def _forward_impl(self, input_ids, positions, forward_batch, input_embeds):
         if input_embeds is None:
             input_embeds = self.forward_embed(input_ids)
+        elif input_embeds.dim() == 2:
+            input_embeds = self._expand_hc(input_embeds)
         x = input_embeds
